sentences.text: FDA first posted the methotrexate sodium injection shortage on 2023-03-13 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage listing includes Accord Healthcare Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Hospira Inc. a Pfizer Company, and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.
The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2016-08-25 and its most recent inspection ended 2025-08-01 with a VAI classification.
A registered plant for Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603) was inspected on 2023-03-24 and classified VAI, 11 days after the shortage posting.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
